biography.on_page: Older regular Jasmine Dragon customer temporarily absent while grieving his sister; chooses how much of their letters to share

personality.voice: Wry, exacting, matter-of-fact, complains about tea and sweeping while retaining his fierce right to privacy.
personality.agency: Can decline visits, letters being read, surprise check-ins and public grief narratives; his shop attendance belongs to him.

boundary: A separate author-created person from Halen named in the Lanternweald Jasmine Steps registry, barring explicit future identification.
